title: Mirabel and the Drop
author: S. M. Montrose
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
